The blobs are arranged in approximately vertical columns, with spacing increasing slightly towards the posterior. The most prominent blobs are located along the central lateral line.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient: high intensity on the superior edge and a defined shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple remoras: one attached to the ventral base of the right pectoral fin and others swimming trailing the ventral midline. Irregular notch-like features or trailing appendages are visible on the posterior edge of the right pectoral fin.
